description: make train's stages (the Makefile's $(TRAIN_DIR)/<stage>.done targets) for the training dashboard: each stage's group, what it runs on (cpu, gpu - one at a time under the GPU lock - or network), the stages it needs (data dependencies), the stages it runs after (ordering only - Make's order-only prerequisites: the CPU checks scheduled into the teacher's GPU-bound hours), its expected minutes (quiet M3 Max, the corpora downloaded once), and the training run it writes ($(TRAIN_DIR)/runs/<run>/ - its data/nn/train.json section, whose stop ends it early); test/testTrainStages.js keeps it in sync with the Makefile

stages.title: The corpora - CMU ARCTIC, LibriTTS-R and its alignments, CREMA-D (downloads, once)
The heteronym relabeling, checked to reproduce data/nn/g2p-relabel.json
The readers' training data (nn.multi build - every core)
The emotional speech's training data (nn.cremad build)
The G2P network's four stages (nn.g2p train - one core, deterministic)
The heteronym context labels (books, aligned readings, part-of-speech tags)
The context G2P - reading stage, context network, export, cross-validation, and nn.context check against the committed module
Teacher stage B with the critic (nn.trainmulti --recipe teacher.b - 20,000 steps)
The teacher through the listener panel (nn.distill eval)
The student's polish on real audio (nn.distill polish)
The student through the panel, and the gate (nn.distill pick: within the teacher's tolerance)
